fields.description: Amounts payable to suppliers and other trade creditors, normally presented as trade payables.

fields.description: Amounts receivable from customers for goods or services, normally net of loss allowance.

aliases_en: adjustments to reconcile profit to cash flows

aliases_en: purchase of property plant and equipment
payments for property plant and equipment

Additions to properties, plant and equipment

fields.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

fields.name_ru: Поступления от продажи основных средств и нематериальных активов

proceeds from disposal of fixed assets
proceeds from sale of intangible assets

fields.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

fields.name_ru: Вложения в ассоциированные организации (общества) и совместные предприятия

fields.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

fields.description: Term or fixed deposits placed with banks that are not classified as cash equivalents.

aliases_en: cash and cash equivalents at end of period
fields.description: Cash on hand, bank balances and short-term highly liquid investments classified as cash and cash equivalents.
fields.hint: Use the Balance Sheet or the closing cash and cash equivalents line in the Cash Flow Statement. Return explicitly disclosed closing dates, including comparative dates. Do not include term deposits or securities unless classified as cash equivalents.
fields.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

aliases_ru: Изменения в операционных активах и обязательствах

fields.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

For Schedule III presentation, use direct cost lines such as cost of materials consumed, purchases of stock-in-trade and changes in inventories only when they form the cost-of-sales block.

fields.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II

aliases_ru: Обязательства по отложенному налогу на прибыль

fields.description: Cash dividends received from associates, joint ventures or other investments.

Equity attributable to owners of the Company

fields.name_ru: Обязательства будущих периодов по капитальным затратам

fields.name_ru: Расход по текущему налогу на прибыль

fields.description: Insurance service expense or claims expense, only for entities with insurance operations.

fields.description: Insurance revenue or insurance service income, only for entities with insurance operations.

fields.description: Cash outflow for purchase of intangible assets.
fields.hint: Use the Cash Flow Statement investing section. Extract purchases/payments for intangible assets. If intangibles are combined with PPE in one line, leave this metric null and use COMBINED_ASSET_PURCHASES.
fields.standard: Ind AS (IFRS-convergent) / Schedule III Division II
